summary: Iteration 8 frontend testing complete. All 3 new features (Footer Live Map, Signature Collection Modal cards, Modal card content/stagger) and 2 bug fixes (Gallery arrows overflow, autoplay pause on touch handlers) verified. All iteration 7 regressions still pass. 22/22 targeted assertions PASS on desktop; mobile viewport also verified.
critical_code_review_comments: components/layout/Footer.tsx is ~524 lines — approaching size limit; consider splitting the LiveMapCard into its own component for readability/reuse.

DishDetailSheet close button (data-testid=dish-sheet-close-N) is functionally correct but Playwright native .click() intermittently times out due to overlapping motion-backdrop hit-testing during exit animation. Programmatic .click() via JS works. Consider adding pointer-events: none on the exit-animating backdrop or bumping close button z-index above the animating backdrop to prevent this in E2E tests.
Pre-existing hydration mismatch warnings on Hero/Menu remain (non-blocking, flagged by main agent as unrelated).
Google Maps iframe correctly uses pointer-events-none so the outer <a> anchor drives navigation — as designed.

Touch handlers onTouchStart/onTouchEnd wired on carousel at Gallery.tsx line 314-315 (couldn't E2E test tap due to hasTouch off in Playwright context but code verified).
